selection: mean eight-panel inner-validation Brier over four locked folds; ties smallest beta
rng: separate reproducible streams for minibatch order, supervised masks and constraint selection; matched supervised draws for shared and every beta
calibration: native sigmoid; no fitted posthoc calibration
primary_summary: mean of five single-seed metrics, not metric of averaged probabilities
uncertainty: paired patient-only bootstrap and crossed patient-by-training-seed bootstrap; no refitting; five-seed distribution limited
ensemble: secondary uniform average of five held-out seed probabilities, reported separately

audit.target: child probability on already outer-held-out records
audit.inputs: parent-visible encoded values/finite flags/query mask only
audit.partition: outcome-blind KFold inside each outer-test fold; each audit parent evaluated by a regressor fitted on other outer-test cases; never feeds back into predictor/tuning
audit.moment_basis: intercept; visible finite flags; visible standardized values clipped to [-3,3]/3; their squares; columns identified from outer-training data
audit.interpretation: projection error includes audit-estimator error; bounded moment checks are necessary not sufficient for full tower consistency

data_handling: observed record states only; no invented biochemical counterfactuals; private checkpoints/caches never released
seed_revision: Spaced seeds prevent initialization reuse across complete training-seed runs; all 25 final seed/fold initialization values distinct; pilot adjacent-seed run preserved.
